description_en: Queries the permissions that are associated with a resource share
description_zh: 调用ListResourceSharePermissions查询共享单元中关联权限的记录
kebab_example: aliyun resourcesharing list-resource-share-permissions --resource-share-id rs-6GRmdD3X0000 --resource-owner Self --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListResourceSharePermissions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_id

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The `token` that is used to initiate the next request. If the response of the current request is truncated, you can use the token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The owner of the resource share. Valid values:

Self: the current account
OtherAccounts: an account other than the current account
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元归属者。取值：

Self：查询当前账号的共享单元列表。
OtherAccounts：查询其他账号共享给当前账号的共享单元列表
parameters.name: resource_owner

NextToken.description_en: The `token` that is used to initiate the next request. If the response of the current request is truncated, you can use the token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

DefaultPermission.description_en:
Indicates whether the permission is the default permission. Valid values:

false: The permission is not the default permission.
true: The permission is the default permission
DefaultPermission.description_zh:
是否为默认权限。取值：

false：不是默认权限。

true：是默认权限

DefaultVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the version is the default version. Valid values:

false: The version is not the default version.
true: The version is the default version
DefaultVersion.description_zh:
共享权限是否为默认版本。取值：

false：不是默认版本。

true：是默认版本

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the shared resources.

For more information about the types of resources that can be shared, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）
ResourceType.description_zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）
